title: Icons with an inline SVG sprite
when: The user wants icons in buttons, menus, lists or beside labels, without an icon font or any download.
prompt:
Goal: An inline SVG sprite of symbols reused with use, sized with the text, colored with currentColor and labeled right.
Steps:
1. Draw each icon on a 24 by 24 viewBox, stroke-width 2, round caps and joins; one style for the whole set.
2. Collect them in one svg at the start of the body with aria-hidden="true" and class="sprite" (hidden with width and height 0), each as <symbol id="icon-search" viewBox="0 0 24 24">.
3. Place one with <svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><use href="#icon-search"></use></svg>.
4. Size in em: .icon { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; stroke: currentColor; fill: none }.
5. Icon beside visible text stays aria-hidden; an icon only button gets aria-label on the button.
6. Keep meanings conventional (magnifier for search, x for close) and keep text labels in navigation.
Quality bar:
- Icons share grid, stroke and corner style.
- Every icon only control has a name.
- Hit area at least 44 px even with a 20 px glyph.
Pitfalls:
- Icon fonts that read as letters and show boxes when blocked.
- Hard coded fills that ignore dark themes.
- Symbol ids clashing with other ids.
Verify:
- [ ] One sprite holds the symbols.
- [ ] Each svg is aria-hidden or has a title.
- [ ] Icon only buttons have aria-label.
- [ ] Icons use currentColor.
Output: The sprite at the start of each page body and the .icon rules in style.css.

examples.input: adicione icones nos botoes do menu
examples.output: sprite with icon-home, icon-search, icon-cart symbols, use href in buttons, icon only cart button with aria-label
